## #IdentityPackage

`#IdentityPackage` is the shape an artifact's committed identity package must match — the two values a release moves, plus everything that derives from them.

**At a glance**

- Source: `src/identity_package.cue` in `opmodel.dev/core@v2`
- Shape: struct, closed
- Uses: [`#ArtifactRef`](/docs/reference/definitions/names-paths-and-versions/#artifactref), [`#ModulePathType`](/docs/reference/definitions/names-paths-and-versions/#modulepathtype), [`#VersionType`](/docs/reference/definitions/names-paths-and-versions/#versiontype)
- Used by: [`#CatalogMemberFQNGate`](/docs/reference/definitions/publish-gates/#catalogmemberfqngate)

**Spec**

```cue
#IdentityPackage: {
    // Written by publish. Byte-identical to cue.mod's `module:` field, major
    // suffix included.
    ModulePath!: #ModulePathType

    // Written by `version set` / `publish --version`. The build every
    // implementation key interpolates.
    Version!: #VersionType

    // RegistryPath: the OCI repository, major-free. Projected through
    // #ArtifactRef rather than split again here — one decomposition site is the
    // whole point of that definition.
    RegistryPath: _ref.registryPath // "opmodel.dev/catalogs/opm"

    // Major: the major the path declares.
    Major: _ref.major // "v1"

    // VersionMajor: derived from Version, never authored, and asserted equal to
    // the major the path declares. The assertion is the second declaration below —
    // unification is the check. This is the only assertion of that relation in the
    // system; deleting it removes the relation outright.
    VersionMajor: "v" + strings.SplitN(Version, ".", 2)[0]
    VersionMajor: Major

    // kindPrefix: the path prefix every catalog member of a given kind hangs off.
    // The major is not re-appended — a catalog member declares a
    // #PackagePathType. Exactly one base prefix per kind; a contract kind files
    // one apiVersion segment beneath it, a transformer at the prefix itself.
    // Enumerated, not a pattern constraint.
    kindPrefix: {
        resources:    RegistryPath + "/resources"
        traits:       RegistryPath + "/traits"
        blueprints:   RegistryPath + "/blueprints"
        transformers: RegistryPath + "/transformers"
    }
}
```

**Notes**

The file it types is `identity/identity.cue`, at the root of a module or a catalog. A publish gate, not a field of any artifact: a publishing tool unifies the loaded package against it.

**Enforcement**

CUE enforces each of these rules on a value unified with `#IdentityPackage`:

- A field the definition does not declare is refused: the definition is closed.
- A value is incomplete until each required field (`!`) is set, and CUE names the missing one when it needs a complete value: `ModulePath`, `Version`.
- `VersionMajor` must satisfy both `"v" + strings.SplitN(Version, ".", 2)[0]` and `Major`.

## #CatalogMemberFQNGate

`#CatalogMemberFQNGate` is the rule a publishing tool unifies every catalog member against — primitive or transformer — to check that what the catalog authored agrees with what its identity package implies.

**At a glance**

- Source: `src/identity_package.cue` in `opmodel.dev/core@v2`
- Shape: struct, closed
- Uses: [`#APIVersionType`](/docs/reference/definitions/names-paths-and-versions/#apiversiontype), [`#FQNType`](/docs/reference/definitions/names-paths-and-versions/#fqntype), [`#IdentityPackage`](/docs/reference/definitions/publish-gates/#identitypackage), [`#NameType`](/docs/reference/definitions/names-paths-and-versions/#nametype), [`#PackagePathType`](/docs/reference/definitions/names-paths-and-versions/#packagepathtype), [`#VersionType`](/docs/reference/definitions/names-paths-and-versions/#versiontype)

**Spec**

```cue
#CatalogMemberFQNGate: {
    identity!: #IdentityPackage
    kind!:     "resources" | "traits" | "blueprints" | "transformers"
    name!:     #NameType

    // What the catalog actually authored.
    declaredFQN!:            #FQNType
    declaredModulePath!:     #PackagePathType
    declaredCatalogVersion!: #VersionType

    // Optional at the top level and required for the three primitive kinds. A
    // transformer declares none — it carries no apiVersion at all — so requiring
    // it unconditionally would force every transformer to author a value nothing
    // reads.
    declaredAPIVersion?: #APIVersionType
    if kind != "transformers" {
        declaredAPIVersion!: #APIVersionType
    }

    // What identity/identity.cue implies. The path must sit under this catalog; a
    // contract kind files one segment beneath its kind prefix, under the member's
    // own apiVersion, a transformer at the prefix itself. The provenance must
    // name this build.
    declaredModulePath: [
        if kind == "transformers" {identity.kindPrefix[kind]},
        identity.kindPrefix[kind] + "/" + declaredAPIVersion,
    ][0]
    declaredCatalogVersion: identity.Version

    // The key does not carry the filing segment: the apiVersion reaches a
    // contract key once, as its "@vN" suffix, never as a path component. Filing
    // is versioned; the key space stays flat.
    declaredFQN: identity.kindPrefix[kind] + "/" + name + "@" + _keyVersion
}
```

**Notes**

A publish gate, not part of any artifact: each `declared*` field is stated twice, once as authored and once as implied, and unification does the comparing.

**Enforcement**

CUE enforces each of these rules on a value unified with `#CatalogMemberFQNGate`:

- A field the definition does not declare is refused: the definition is closed.
- A value is incomplete until each required field (`!`) is set, and CUE names the missing one when it needs a complete value: `identity`, `kind`, `name`, `declaredFQN`, `declaredModulePath`, `declaredCatalogVersion`, `declaredAPIVersion` when `kind != "transformers"`.
- `declaredFQN` must satisfy both `#FQNType` and `identity.kindPrefix[kind] + "/" + name + "@" + _keyVersion`.
- `declaredModulePath` must satisfy both `#PackagePathType` and `[if kind == "transformers" {identity.kindPrefix[kind]}, identity.kindPrefix[kind] + "/" + declaredAPIVersion][0]`.
- `declaredCatalogVersion` must satisfy both `#VersionType` and `identity.Version`.

## #TraitOptionalGate

What `opm catalog publish` unifies against, once per published [`#Trait`](/docs/reference/definitions/resources-traits-and-blueprints/#trait), to hold catalogs to the two rules [`#Trait.optional`](/docs/reference/definitions/resources-traits-and-blueprints/#trait) cannot express itself: a posture is stated, and it is not pinned.

**At a glance**

- Source: `src/trait.cue` in `opmodel.dev/core@v2`
- Shape: struct, closed

**Spec**

```cue
#TraitOptionalGate: {
    // The value under test: some published trait's `optional`.
    optional: bool
}
```

**Notes**

Takes the field, not the trait, and must be unified into a non-hidden value.

**Enforcement**

CUE enforces each of these rules on a value unified with `#TraitOptionalGate`:

- A field the definition does not declare is refused: the definition is closed.
- `((optional & true) != _|_) && ((optional & false) != _|_)` must hold (`_overridable`).
